issues: 按 480×270 设计坐标放大，立方体特写时面的上下出画，面上 6–10px 的设计字放大后仍是小字
画面只有一个立方体居中，左右大片空黑，观众不知道一共几个模块、现在在第几面
相机五段等时长 inOutCubic 机械步进，hold 段完全静止
结尾停在一个等轴立方体上，没有收口的标题或海报画面
changes: look 换成 graphite（近单色暗场），六面色相压成同一明度的深色釉面，强调色只给各面的主数据
改为 1920 成片坐标直接搭：S=760 的立方体特写时 ≈1.1× 放大、整面完整入画，主数字 150–160px、说明 32px，文字按近原生尺寸栅格化
构图偏右（立方体中心 58%），左侧加模块索引栏，高亮条按转向角连续滑到当前面，舞台余光与地面落地光随当前面换色
换面改成「拉远+转向 → 等轴顶点悬停 → 转向+推近」的弧，推拉与转向错峰 3–4f，全程叠极缓匀速漂移，hold 段不再死帧
面内容各有小动作：折线描出 + 计数、柱子错峰长起、里程碑点亮；背光面不渲染以省栅格
时长 180→240f，收尾拉到更高更远的等轴，左上两行大标题遮罩升起，成一张陈列海报
issuesEn: Built in a 480x270 design space and scaled up: close-ups cropped the faces top and bottom, and the 6–10px design text was still small after scaling
A lone centred cube with empty black on both sides: no sense of how many modules exist or which face you are on
Five equal-length inOutCubic camera steps felt mechanical, and the holds were completely static
It ended on an isometric cube with no closing title or poster frame
changesEn: Graphite look (near-monochrome dark stage); the six face hues are pressed to one value as dark glazed panels, with accent colour only on each face's key figure
Built directly in 1920 frame space: an S=760 cube at ~1.1x in close-up with the whole face in frame, 150–160px key numbers and 32px captions, text rasterised near native size
Off-centre composition (cube at 58%) with a module index rail on the left whose highlight slides continuously to the current face; stage tint and floor glow follow the face hue
Face changes are now arcs (pull back and turn, hang at the isometric apex, turn and push in), with dolly and rotation offset by 3–4f and a slow constant drift so holds never freeze
Each face has a small beat of its own: line draw plus count-up, staggered bars, milestones lighting up; back-facing faces are skipped to save raster time
Duration 180 to 240f, ending on a higher, wider isometric view with a two-line headline rising in the top left as a showcase poster
